title: Student demonstration at Timor-Leste National Parliament over vehicle purchase and pension policy
location: Outside the National Parliament, Dili; wider demonstrations reported in Dili over 15–17 September
participant_identity: EUTL and university students; International IDEA reports broader student demonstrations
organizer: EUTL for the 15 September action; common organizer across the 15–17 September sequence not established
state_target: National Parliament and government policy on purchase of 65 Prado vehicles for MPs and lifetime pensions
participants_estimate: International IDEA reports more than 2,000 across 15–17 September; this is a multi-day aggregate and does not establish simultaneous attendance at one gathering

start_date.summary: TATOLI dates EUTL action to 15 September; IDEA describes demonstrations from 15–17 September.

end_date.summary: IDEA describes the demonstration period as 15–17 September; the exact end time and whether all actions were continuous are unknown.

location.summary: TATOLI reports a gathering outside the National Parliament in Dili; IDEA describes demonstrations in Dili.

participants.summary: IDEA reports over 2,000 in aggregate across three days; this does not establish a single-meeting simultaneous count.

organizer.summary: TATOLI identifies EUTL students at the Parliament action; organizer continuity for the wider multi-day sequence is not established.

demands.summary: TATOLI reports opposition to the vehicle purchase; IDEA also reports demands concerning MPs’ pensions.

state_target.summary: The reported demands concern Parliament/government vehicle procurement and MP pension policy.

state_response.summary: TATOLI reports party-group cancellation announcement; IDEA says vehicle procurement was cancelled Sep 16. No response to pension demand established.

open_questions: What was the number simultaneously present at a particular public gathering, rather than the multi-day aggregate?
Were the 15–17 September actions a continuous common episode with a shared organizer and demand set?
Was there a documented state response to the pension demand?
coding_notes: Keep the vehicle and pension demands and their response scope distinct; do not convert the 2,000 multi-day aggregate into a simultaneous crowd count.
